# streamlit-extras

> A community-driven collection of focused Python utilities and UI components for Streamlit apps. Install the package and import each extra from its own `streamlit_extras.<name>` module.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://arnaudmiribel.github.io/streamlit-extras/): Overview and example.
- [Getting started](https://arnaudmiribel.github.io/streamlit-extras/getting_started/): Install and run an app.
- [Browse extras](https://arnaudmiribel.github.io/streamlit-extras/extras/): Generated API pages with imports and examples.
- [Contributing](https://arnaudmiribel.github.io/streamlit-extras/contributing/): Add an extra and run checks.
- [Agent guide](https://arnaudmiribel.github.io/streamlit-extras/agents/): Guidelines for agent-assisted contributions.
- [Component approaches](https://arnaudmiribel.github.io/streamlit-extras/components/): Links to Streamlit component resources.

## Repository references

- [Project agent instructions](https://github.com/arnaudmiribel/streamlit-extras/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Metadata, tests, and project layout.
- [Extra implementation guidance](https://github.com/arnaudmiribel/streamlit-extras/blob/main/src/streamlit_extras/AGENTS.md): Python, HTML, and component choices.
- [Contribution notes](https://github.com/arnaudmiribel/streamlit-extras/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): New functions and existing packages.

## Quick start

Install with `pip install streamlit-extras` (Python 3.10+). For example, use `from streamlit_extras.stoggle import stoggle` and call `stoggle("More", "Details")` in a Streamlit script. Run with `streamlit run app.py`.

To contribute, add a self-contained module under `src/streamlit_extras/`, register a typed public function using `@extra`, and provide `__title__`, `__desc__`, `__icon__`, `__author__`, and `__examples__`. Run `uv run pytest` and `uv run ruff check .`; inspect behavior in the gallery. For React-based components, build the frontend and check the wheel with `uv build`. Treat agent-generated code as a draft requiring review, including accessibility, theme integration, and escaping of untrusted content.
